configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Common settings. Builds into build-presets/<preset>, which keeps the preset trees out of the hand-configured build/ and build-u8string/ directories.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Release build, examples in all three development modes.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Debug build. ASSERT() is live here since 2812c547 (the guard is now NDEBUG-based) and in Release it compiles out, so this is the configuration that checks the library's internal invariants.

configurePresets.name: sanitize
configurePresets.description: Debug build with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer. See DUI_ENABLE_SANITIZERS. Skia is built with ASan too, into lib/<config>-asan, and that is not optional: an instrumented dui linked against the uninstrumented Skia disagrees with it about the layout of every type containing a SkTArray, and ASan then reports heap-buffer-overflows inside objects Skia allocated. Expect a full Skia build the first time this preset is used in a tree.

configurePresets.name: cef
configurePresets.description: Release build with the CEF browser integration and the cef/CefBrowser examples. CEF is downloaded by cmake/dui_deps.cmake on first configure.

configurePresets.name: mvvm
configurePresets.description: Release build with the optional MVVM data-binding module (docs/Binding.md).

configurePresets.name: xml
configurePresets.description: Only the XML-mode examples, for a much shorter build.

testPresets.name: sanitize
testPresets.description: Runs the sanitized tests. Note: no detect_leaks here on purpose. LeakSanitizer does not exist in the macOS ASan runtime, and asking for it there is fatal, not ignored: the process exits at startup with 'AddressSanitizer: detect_leaks is not supported on this platform'. Leak detection is on by default on Linux anyway. halt_on_error=0 keeps a run going so that one crash does not hide the errors behind it; a run is still reported as failed.
